140471518514522.name: Project Halo [Still in remaking]
140471518514522.description:
The Gate Zero Incident

Setting
Set in the Blue Archive universe, years before modern Kivotos and the academies existed. Back then, SCHALE was a secret military black-ops team cleaning up corporate disasters.

Story
A tech company dug deep underground into ancient ruins at Site Gate Zero. They tried to use Pyroxene crystals to artificially create a Mystic and a synthetic Halo. 

The experiment failed horribly. The crystal core sent out a signal that hijacked the minds and bodies of all 847 staff members. The victims are still awake and aware inside their own heads, crying and begging for help, but their bodies are forced to shoot at anyone who enters.

The Mission
You lead a SCHALE squad sent into the facility. Your goal is to fight down to the bottom floor, recover the research data, and burn the crystal core before the signal spreads outside.
